_readme: Changeset for Beach Builders Marina Ph1 CD90 -> CD100 per mock CBO review 07/2026.
Each entry: comment (review item #), scope (sheet numbers or 'ALL'), find, replace, notes.
Matching is exact substring, case-sensitive. Run DRY_RUN first and read the audit.
Entries with VERIFY require EOR confirmation before the live run.

replacements.notes: If code table uses separate cells, the pair below catches the standalone value.
